qa: Yes, it triggers. The suspending and the timing for getting +1000 DP are the same, therefore the [All Turns] effect triggers.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack. [All Turns] When a Digimon with 13000 DP or more attacks, this Digimon may digivolve into [Marsmon] or [Callismon] in the hand without paying the cost.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
